Alex (PM): Quick sync — need to lock prioritization for the staged experiments initiative. Customer asks (ACME) + internal risk guardrails.
Mira (Eng): ok. what's the top constraint? time vs risk vs cost?
Alex (PM): All three. ACME wants private/dedicated early. We can't deliver full private infra before launch; my proposal: canary for everyone + private beta for 2 customers.
Sophie (Product): RICE sketch for ACME ask: reach=0.15, impact=8, confidence=0.6, effort=5 => score ~0.144. high impact but moderate confidence.
Cassie (ML): On the model side we can offer quantized variant as an automated fallback to cut token cost. Runtime switch effort ~3w (1.5 engs).
Jon (SRE): Safety needs: auto-rollback triggers: 95p latency >1.2s OR error_rate uplift >1.0 percentage point. Also need a visible kill-switch.
Alex (PM): Proposed canary plan: start at 1% traffic, ramp to 5% over 48-72h if metrics stable; check every 15m; fallback to model_v2q if quality dip >2% for seeded prompts and trigger manual review for anything >4%.
Mira (Eng): I'd prefer 1% -> 3% -> 5% with waits at each step, not a flat 3% for 48h. Also require console-level kill switch and a runbook.
Jon (SRE): +1 to gradual ramp. Add a chaos check in staging (network partition) before canary.
Sophie (Product): Draft launch criteria: - ERR_RATE <= baseline + 0.5% sustained for 72h; - 95th latency within 10% of baseline; - user-rated quality regression <1.5% on seeded eval set; - on-call ack <15m for kill alerts.
Alex (PM): If we agree, we prioritize initiatives: A) staged canary + automated fallback; B) private beta for priority customers; C) full private GA. Sequencing: A then B then C.
Cassie (ML): I can provide a 500-prompt seeded eval set + a diff script for canary checks. Need CI hook to run after each deploy.
Mira (Eng): Resource ask: 1 infra eng + 1 runtime eng for 4w to implement switching, dashboards, and the kill-switch.
Alex (PM): Tradeoff: compressing timeline means we either shorten canary windows (more risk) or skip private beta (customer pain). Which do we take?
Sophie (Product): We can skip private beta only if ACME takes dedicated earlier at a price (SLA). Otherwise we need the beta to buy time.
Jon (SRE): I'm ok with compressed timeline if we invest in automation (alerts + auto-rollback). That moves effort to infra but reduces ops overhead during launch.
Alex (PM): Decision request: thumbs up to proceed with 1%->5% ramp, 72h metric checks, fallback to quantized variant, private beta scoped to 2 customers, and put it into the RICE queue now?
Mira (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sophie (Product): :thumbsup:
Cassie (ML): :thumbsup:
Jon (SRE): :thumbsup:
Jon (SRE): Proposed rollout config for the canary: 
```
{"traffic_split": {"canary": 0.01, "prod": 0.99}, "metrics": {"err_rate_threshold": 0.015, "latency_95p_ms": 1200}, "ramp_steps": [1,3,5], "check_interval_min": 15}
```
Alex (PM): Ok I'll update the spec + attach RICE table. Cassie, please drop the eval set into the repo. Mira, please make infra tickets.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: job-id=ci-canary-2026-03, initial_traffic=1%
Alex (PM): I'll file the follow-up doc (spec + runbooks) and assign infra tickets. Thanks everyone.
